staging_note: STAGED DESIGN COPY, not wired. Stage 1 pool = the S2 deferred 4-line pool — same landing dependency as Erin (~22 canonical-script reds measured for Relc in S2); chatted_with_relc does not accrue until it lands.

lines: Hah! There's my favorite punching bag. Kidding — the dummies are my favorite. You're a close third after lunch.
You're standing straighter. See that? That's me. I'm basically a [Teacher]. Don't tell the Watch, they'll dock my pay for moonlighting.
Quiet shift. If anything with teeth shows up, you'll hear me laughing before you hear the bell.
There they are. You know what I like about you? You went DOWN the creepy hole. Most people file a report about the hole. From upstairs.
Zevara smiled this week. Actual smile. The warren's sealed and the city's still standing — I'm taking full credit and handing you most of it.
Next time something ugly crawls out of the ground, I'm not even worried. That's new for me. Don't make it weird.

hub_options._flag: CANON ⚑ — Embria is a Volume 5 reveal (wiki/Embria): NO daughter, no family named in the staged copy. A warmer 'family thing' variant exists in the .md companion, default OUT.

relc_army.speaker: Relc
relc_army.text: Ha! No. Army, before. Liscor's got one — it just never comes home. I did. Walls pay worse, but nobody makes you march in the rain, and I am DONE with marching. Best decision I ever made, after the spear.

relc_army_two.speaker: Relc
relc_army_two.text: Long version costs a drink. Short version: I got tired of holes in the ground and people I liked going into them. Watch work, the worst thing I dig is paperwork. ...What? I can be deep. It's the tail, nobody expects it.

relc_after.speaker: Relc
relc_after.text: Miss it? I left people in it. Some I'd still take a spear for, even now. That's all the answer you're getting sober. ...Hey. You did good, down there. I don't say that to walls, so stand still while it lands.

perk.summary: ⚑ Spec default is 'a repeatable spar' — relc_spar already re-offers, so that perk is already true as specced. Refinement proposal: at stage 3, winning the spar once per waking flips you 1 gold ('wager', with a complaint about Watch pay). Visible currency, tiny, very Relc; needs the per-waking dedup seam (entity_first_use verb-prefix) on the spar reward. User picks: status quo, wager, or another shape.
